label: Ascent at every world, from the cause-is-more principle and the every-world bridge
meaning: Derives the every-world ascent premise, and through it both the J2 ascent premise and the actual-grounding ascent premise, from the unrestricted Aristotelian cause principle and the every-world bridge from support to causing being. Because neither the cause dictionary nor the comparative takes a world argument, the bridge is where rigidity enters: whoever supports a thing's being at any world is a cause of its being, hence more in esse, at every world. Conditional consequence only; the bridge and the principle remain open.
